<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template identified in task make_8_lvl2-template_search-6, then apply it to the target molecule (flavanone) to get precursors. Since we don't have the template ID, we can search the template catalog using the described functional group changes: broken ketones and aromatic hydroxyls, formed ether oxygens, bonds formed C-C and C-O, bond broken C-O. We'll use the flavanone SMILES as the target molecule. Then we can apply the found template(s) to get precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(O)C2=CC=CC=C2C1c3ccccc3",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
